manifestAggregateAlgorithm: 1) For each file in the fixed 19-file manifest below, compute SHA-256 of its exact raw bytes. 2) Sort the manifest by relative repo-root path (ASCII/codepoint sort). 3) Build the aggregate input string by concatenating, in that sorted order, one line per file formatted exactly as '<relativePath>:<sha256hex>\n' (no other separators, no trailing blank line beyond the final file's own newline). 4) CANONICAL_WALKER_QUALIFIED_ID = 'sha256:' + hex(SHA-256(aggregate input string, encoded UTF-8)). Recompute with: node scripts/canonicalWalkerQualifiedId.mjs (prints the same value as this receipt's canonicalWalkerQualifiedId when the manifest is unchanged).

qualificationSummary.productionDoorFidelity: Every action category the Walker uses (attack/dodge/block/advance/retreat/flee/heal, travel, rest, equip, resurrection, Guardian summon) routes through a real production door via CanonicalActionExecutor. The one historical bypass (RCH-002, travel through live enemies) is closed and regression-tested (canonicalTravelEnemyGuard.test.ts).
qualificationSummary.observabilityFirewall: policy.ts imports nothing but playerView.ts (statically proven, canonicalFirewallStatic.test.ts). Zero privileged/hidden-state fields reach decide()/buildOptions(). The forensic-only combat-log trace (CombatRoundTrace.logDelta) is proven never read by policy. Telemetry attachment proven not to perturb gameplay (canonicalObserverNonPerturbation.test.ts, identical RNG sequence/state with telemetry on vs off).
qualificationSummary.rngDeterminism: Single seeded Math.random() stream, reseeded once per canonical boot via the OTA-1831-corrected __TARTARIA_RESEED_RANDOM__ hook. No forced die results (canonicalDiceFidelity.test.ts). No stack-read side channel (canonicalRngNoStackReads.test.ts). Single, gapless stream per life (canonicalRngSingleStream.test.ts). Artifact-identity UUIDs (artifactIdentity.ts) use crypto.randomUUID(), a wholly separate source from gameplay RNG.
qualificationSummary.ordinaryCombatAndRangeReach: Range/reach observability (PlayerViewEnemy.rangeLabel/mainHandReach) is built from the SAME production resolvers (enemyBandOf/playerWeaponReach) the real attack-reach gate and the real UI use — not a parallel mechanic. ADVANCE/RETREAT route through real submitPlayerAction('advance'|'retreat') -> runMoveCombatRange(), provoking real enemy counter-attacks. Proven in canonicalPlayerViewRangeReach.test.ts, canonicalActionExecutorMovement.test.ts, canonicalContextualCombatPolicy.test.ts, and demonstrated live in the Task-2 Life 3 reproduction (150-round stalemate -> 3-round ADVANCE/ADVANCE/counterattack/FLEE).
qualificationSummary.guardianCombatQualification: Isolated qualification (this apparatus's Phase 13 experiment, not re-executed by this freeze task): a production-summoned Guardian (Sentinel-Priest Vaelka, Asgardar, tier 1) was carried through real production combat (real ADVANCE on a reach mismatch, real enemy counter-attack, real ATTACK resolution) to GUARDIAN_DEFEATED in 6 of a 300-round budget. Production's own death handler awarded the Core, marked the Guardian defeated, and advanced mainQuest.phase automatically -- no manual grant. The isolation fixture that placed the character at the summon seam was proven (canonicalGuardianCombatIsolationFixture.test.ts) to change zero combat-power fields and consume zero RNG draws.

All prior life3-run and guardian-combat evidence files remain present and byte-unmodified.

knownNonblockingLimitations: 1. Fresh-character natural survivability to Guardian 1 remains UNPROVEN. This is a Life 4 gameplay question, not an apparatus blocker. The one attempt under the unmodified canonical seed/creation (canonicalGuardianFightCompletion.test.ts, Phase 12) died to an ordinary wilderness encounter before reaching the summon seam; that RNG/creation identity was deliberately NOT varied to chase a friendlier journey, per owner instruction.

2. The Guardian 300-round ceiling remains UNCHANGED. One historical Guardian encounter (canonical Life 3, cycle 2) reached the 300-round cap without resolving. The current qualification (a 6-round Guardian kill) does NOT establish that 300 is universally sufficient, nor does the historical stall establish that it is insufficient -- both remain true, unreconciled facts.

Both executions were fully deterministic (same seed, same fixture, same everything) and produced byte-identical qualification results (verified field-by-field: finalVerdict, terminal, roundsConsumed, startState, coreConsequence, isolationProof). This was not a rerun for a more favorable outcome, and it must not be executed again merely for confidence -- the evidence already on disk stands.
